name: VibeTree
headline: VibeTree - AI Git Worktree Collaboration
short_description: VibeTree enables developers to collaborate with Claude AI in parallel git worktrees. It allows teams to maintain multiple branches of code simultaneously, streamlining workflows and reducing merge conflicts. Integrates with git, Claude, and TypeScript for efficient coding.
author: sahithvibudhi

sections.overview:
VibeTree is a cross-platform application that enhances development workflows by enabling parallel development with AI assistance across multiple git worktrees. It allows developers to work on multiple features simultaneously without context switching or stashing branches, maintaining persistent terminal sessions for each worktree. The tool integrates Claude CLI for seamless AI collaboration and supports IDE integration with VS Code and Cursor. VibeTree is accessible from desktop, web browser, and mobile devices, with Docker deployment options for cloud environments. It solves the problem of linear development workflows by enabling true parallel work on features while preserving terminal state and reducing merge conflicts.
Work on multiple features in parallel without switching git branches or stashing code
Collaborate with Claude AI in separate terminal sessions for each feature branch
Deploy development environments to AWS EC2 or Digital Ocean with one-command Docker setup
Access code and terminals from desktop, mobile, or web browser across LAN or cloud
sections.usage:
```
Use VibeTree to set up parallel git worktrees for [PROJECT_NAME] with [NUMBER] branches based on [BASE_BRANCH]. For each branch, generate a [TASK_DESCRIPTION] to implement [FEATURE_NAME]. Include TypeScript code snippets for the core logic and document the expected API changes in [DOCUMENTATION_FILE].
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
